goal: Iske baad aap std::string declare kar ke bhar sakte hain, ek lafz ya poori line parh sakte hain, bacha hua newline wala trap avoid kar sakte hain, length maloom kar sakte hain, ek ek character dekh sakte hain aur strings ko + se jor sakte hain.
warmup: Aap ka naam, roll number aur address sab text hain. Hostel ke form par aap inhein boxes mein likhte hain. Puranay C style ke boxes (char arrays) mein squares ki tadad tay hoti hai: agar aap ka naam boxes se lamba ho to masla ho jata hai. C++ aap ko ek jaadui form deta hai jis ki line jo bhi aap likhein uske hisab se phail jati hai. Yehi string class hai.
definition: String characters ka silsila hai, yani text. C++ mein iski do qismein hain. C-string ek char array hai jo ek chhupe hue \0 (null) character par khatam hota hai aur jis ka size tay hota hai. std::string class (header <string>) zyada aasaan hai: yeh khud barhti hai, = se copy ho sakti hai, + se jori ja sakti hai aur == se compare ho sakti hai. Is course mein hum zyada tar std::string use karte hain. Har character ka ek number hota hai jise uska ASCII code kehte hain (A 65 hai, a 97 hai, 0 48 hai).
howItWorks: DECLARE: string s; khali string banata hai, string s = "Hello"; usay bhar deta hai. PARHNA: cin >> s sirf EK lafz parhta hai, kyunke yeh pehle space par ruk jata hai. Poori line parhne ke liye, jaise poora naam, getline(cin, s) use karein. TRAP: cin >> age; ke baad jo Enter aap ne dabaya woh abhi input mein pada rehta hai. Uske foran baad wala getline line ka woh khali bacha hua hissa parh leta hai aur aisa lagta hai ke skip ho gaya. Ilaaj yeh hai ke dono ke beech cin.ignore(); likhein, jo us ek Enter ko phenk deta hai. SIZE: s.length() (ya s.size()) characters ki tadad deta hai. std::string ke liye yeh chhupe hue \0 ko nahi ginta. CHARACTERS: s[0] pehla character hai aur s[s.length() - 1] aakhri. s.at(i) wohi karta hai, lekin index check karta hai. [] se string ke bahar index karna ek bug hai jo compiler nahi pakarta. Ehtiyat: length() ki type unsigned (size_t) hoti hai, is liye loops mein size_t i use karein aur khali string par s.length() - 1 se hoshiyar rahein. LOOP: for (size_t i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) har character par jata hai; visual mein HELLO boxes ki qatar ki tarah dikhaya gaya hai, jis mein har character apne ASCII code ke tor par store hai. JORNA: a + b nayi string banata hai. Aap s + "!" ya s += "!" likh sakte hain, lekin "Hi" + " there" (do saade quoted text) allowed nahi hai: ek taraf string honi chahiye. COMPARE KE LIYE C-STRINGS: char name[30] = "Ali"; ko assign karne ke liye strcpy, jorne ke liye strcat aur compare karne ke liye strcmp chahiye; std::string sirf =, + aur == use karti hai.
